Topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
Topology.Description: A secure hierarchical network design for a government entity, including an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connectivity for remote sites.
Topology.Summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge zone with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to regional and branch offices. Remote sites have local routing and switching.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management' zone with a node labeled 'Asset Management System' (n28) that is connected to various network devices and zones, indicating the presence of an asset management system.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' zone with a node labeled 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n29) that is connected to various network devices and zones, indicating the presence of a data flow documentation system.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) and a 'Data Center' (z2) with a firewall (n11) and a server (n15) in the data center, indicating segmentation of data processing and storage based on sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Server Firewall' (n30) connected to the 'Data Center Server' (n15), indicating the implementation of a firewall on the server.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n18) and a 'DNS Filter' (n19) in the 'Internet Edge' zone, indicating the presence of trusted DNS servers.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' (n3) and an 'Identity Server' (n16) connected to it, indicating the requirement for MFA for remote network access.

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n19) in the 'Internet Edge' zone, indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n20) in the 'Internet Edge' zone, indicating the presence of network-based URL filters.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (Internet Edge, Data Center, Regional Office, Branch Office, Management Zone, Non-Production Zone, External Testing Zone) with appropriate firewalls, switches, and routers, indicating a secure network architecture.

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tools' zone with a node labeled 'IaC Tool' (n31) that is connected to various network devices and zones, indicating the use of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) for managing network infrastructure.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n16) and a 'SIEM' (n17) in the 'Management Zone', indicating centralized network AAA.

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' (n3) and an 'Identity Server' (n16) connected to it, indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n21) in the 'Internet Edge' zone, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple firewalls (n1, n11, n30) and links between different zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' (n3) and an 'Identity Server' (n16) connected to it, indicating the management of access control for remote assets.

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Collection System' (n32) connected to various network devices and zones, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) and a 'Data Center' (z2) with a firewall (n11) and a server (n15) in the data center, indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'External Testing Zone' (z7) with a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n27) and a 'Penetration Testing Management System' (n33) connected to it, indicating the capability to perform periodic external penetration tests.
